description:
About the Team

Droyd builds autonomous robotic systems that automate repetitive manual work in real environments. We design and manufacture our hardware in-house, which means iteration, fabrication, and execution all happen under one roof.

Our test team keeps demo and evaluation systems running, builds realistic test environments, and prepares the company for pilot deployments — spanning end effector testing, motor and firmware evaluation, demo execution, competitive bakeoffs, and eventually forward deployment and teleoperator coordination.

About the Role

As a Test Forward Deployed Engineer at Droyd, you will help build, operate, and support test environments that mirror real deployments. You will work across hardware setup, systems integration, demos, and pilot preparation, and over time help bridge the gap between internal testing and real-world deployment.

This is a highly practical role for someone comfortable working across software, systems, hardware setup, and field-style execution.

This role is based on-site in San Francisco, CA.

In This Role, You'll

Test & Demo Environments

 - Build and maintain realistic test and demo environments

 - Support system setup, integration, and operational readiness for pilots and internal testing

 - Help manage hardware, infrastructure, and operational tooling needed for forward deployment

Demos & Pilot Preparation

 - Work closely with the test team on demos, bakeoffs, and pilot preparation

 - Support workflows that may later extend to teleoperators and field operations

Engineering Bridge

 - Act as a bridge between engineering development and real-world deployment needs

 - Troubleshoot and integrate messy real-world systems quickly

Work Environment & Schedule

 - On-site in San Francisco, CA

 - Full-time

Compensation: $110K–$150K base salary, plus equity

We're Looking For Candidates Who

 - Are highly practical and comfortable working across hardware and software systems

 - Can troubleshoot and integrate messy real-world systems quickly

 - Work well in ambiguous, fast-moving environments

 - Are comfortable owning operational and technical problems end-to-end

 - Thrive close to hardware and deployment-style work

Nice to have:

 - Experience in forward deployed engineering, field engineering, solutions engineering, or technical operations

 - Experience with robotics, infrastructure, or hardware-adjacent systems

 - Experience supporting demos, pilots, or customer deployments

About Droyd

Droyd builds autonomous robotic systems that operate in real production environments. We design the hardware, develop the control stack, and generate the data that enables generalist robotics.

If we do this right, robots stop being demos and start being infrastructure.

Join us and help build the systems that make it real.
